title: I'm Giving the Disgraced Noble Lady I Rescued a Crash Course in Naughtiness
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Allen, a reclusive sorcerer feared locally as the 'Demon Lord', rescues Charlotte, a noblewoman framed by her fiancé the prince and forced to flee (Kodansha USA blurb via MangaUpdates). He takes her into his mansion and resolves to teach her 'naughty' pleasures such as good food and fashion to make her the happiest woman in the world. A comedic fantasy romance adapted from a light novel.
life_message: Someone who has been wronged deserves to be cared for, to enjoy simple pleasures and to find happiness again.
